transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining. As you all know, the Customer Programs and Implementation teams were merged last month and have been operating under a temporary working agreement. The draft agreement covers meeting conduct, employee feedback, and routes for raising interpersonal concerns. Before I approve the final charter and its implementation commitments, I want to follow our normal practice: I'd like to hear from each affected team member and HR one concern and one requested safeguard. Let's go around and start collecting those inputs.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I want to share something I've observed. In four recent meetings, I've noticed the same senior colleague repeatedly interrupting newer team members before they could finish speaking. I hadn't raised this with you, Helena, because I didn't want to be seen as accusing that colleague of bad intent. But since we're discussing meeting conduct and routes for raising interpersonal concerns, I think it's relevant.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I want to share something relevant to the employee feedback section of the draft. When the merger was announced, Helena informally promised me that the merged team would retain an anonymous feedback form for the first 60 days. I haven't brought this up before because it was a private conversation, and I notice the draft charter doesn't specify a duration for the anonymous feedback form. I think this matters for the safeguard discussion, so I wanted to put it on the table.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I'd like to share HR's concern and safeguard. I confirmed with Employee Relations this week that when an interpersonal concern involves an employee's direct manager, it must be accepted through a skip-level HR intake route rather than only through that manager. This confirmation has not yet been added to the draft charter. My concern is that the current draft doesn't explicitly include this skip-level route, which could leave employees without a viable path if their concern involves their manager. My requested safeguard is that we add this skip-level HR intake route to the charter before final approval.
